Offline Android command builder for Instagram and Termux. The app creates commands only; it does not download media or query links.

- Four modes: best video + audio, silent video, best source audio with artwork, and StillClip.
- One command for multiple links, optional item positions, and multiple video cuts.
- Consistent username-date-time-counter filenames.
- Persistent Link Notes in a full-screen AMOLED panel.
- Redundant local state, recovery from damaged records, history, and full JSON/TXT exports.
- Double-back exit and no ads, analytics, internet or storage permissions.

Requires Android 10+. Run generated commands in Termux with yt-dlp and FFmpeg installed.

This APK uses the Release signing key, which can differ from earlier debug APKs. Export your settings, notes and history before replacing an installation with a different signature. The release does not add JSON import.
